note: Founding artifacts are registered in place. They are never moved, renamed, or edited. A sha256 change means the source moved under us and every claim citing it must be re-verified.

sources.title: Identity / Typological Vault
sources.measures: Self as type. 40+ classification systems applied to one person.
sources.limit: Self-selected typology. Highest comfort, lowest predictive value. Nothing here is measured by anyone but the subject.

sources.title: Memory re-export (JSON)
sources.measures: Self as observed by an instrument, longitudinally.
sources.limit: Already tiered by its author. The tiering is the useful part; the model's inferences are T1 at best and must be re-evidenced before use.
sources.line_count_method: splitlines(); the file has no trailing newline, so `wc -l` reports 603

sources.title: Zazie Exact-Name Media Master
sources.measures: Self as cited by the world.
sources.limit: Proves an exact-name public record exists. Does NOT validate any biographical, award, or review claim made by the source.

sources.title: Forensic Public-Image Audit — Instagram
sources.evidence_base: 14 of 29 grid posts, 8 tagged-tab items, 8 public comments, bio & stats, 2 highlight titles
sources.measures: Self as perceived by a stranger in thirty seconds.
sources.limit: Logged-out view only, 14 of 29 posts. Point-in-time. Perception, not conduct. Makes no diagnosis and infers no motive.

sources.title: Shadow / Signal / Stewardship — Mega Compendium
sources.measures: Self as possible. The adversarial atlas.
sources.limit: Most seductive document in the repo. Thought experiments, not predictions. Persona names are fictional composites. Every archetype requires a behavioral falsifier before it may enter the case file.

sources.title: Complete Discography
sources.measures: Self as output. The only record in the vault that cannot be argued with.
sources.limit: ISRCs validated via Deezer API at compile time. '—' means no ISRC found, not a missing value. Never fabricate ISRCs.
